_comment: FROZEN. Do not edit to make a red test green — find out what diverged. This fixture owns its config so balance tuning cannot silently change the expected hash. The hash legitimately changed once, at step 4, when towers began shooting: the match itself is different, not the arithmetic.
_coverage: At these values the match kills 7 creeps and leaves 5 alive having each completed 2 laps, with 18 leaks taking lives from 20 down to 2 — so one fixture exercises death, survival, looping, damage persisting across laps, and the leak-costs-a-life rule, stopping just short of defeat. Match-end is covered by unit tests instead, because lengthening this fixture past the loss would freeze the sim and stop exercising everything after it.
